AAGL’s prior congress housing policy states that AAGL controls official hotel housing, uses hotel blocks for exhibitors, and directs housing questions to the AAGL meetings function.
Kenita Hidalgo’s current profile identifies her as AAGL Events/Marketing/Membership and explicitly lists event operations, meetings management, budget administration and contract negotiations.
AAGL’s AAGL27 archive identifies Kenita Hidalgo as the author of the 2027 Global Congress announcement.
Linda Michels is identified as AAGL’s current Executive Director.
Roman Bojorquez is identified as AAGL’s current Director of Operations.
Roman Bojorquez’s operations role is additionally described as covering AAGL operations and information-technology/project-development work.
